Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
gang...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> Can I play amaranth and Ritual of the bitter rose with an "Illusionary
> vampire". ?

Yes, so long as the Illusionary Vampire is not on his way to torpor (or
an Assamite).

The vampire put into play by Illusions of the Kindred is treated exactly
like any other vampire (except that he doesn't contest other vampires) -
he doesn't have any sort of "illusionary" penalties or restrictions
(except that he will be removed from the game at the end of the combat).

> Ok, and what about Psyche ?

(Please quote enough context to allow readers to understand your posts.)

Psyche! can be played to press.
The superior version can only be used if both combatants are still ready,
by card text, and being out of the game doesn't qualify as "ready".

As LSJ said :
There is no room to play Psyche (superior) between the time Illusions
of Kindred ends combat and when the new combat begins. So, when you
play Illusions of Kindred, Psyche cannot be played.[LSJ 19971003]
